sloka: परावरज्ञो यश्च स्यात्तथा त्वं मनुजाधिप ।स एवं व्यसनं प्राप्य न विषीदितुमर्हति ॥ २.१०६.५॥
transliteration: parāvarajño yaśca syāttathā tvaṁ manujādhipa ।sa evaṁ vyasanaṁ prāpya na viṣīditumarhati ॥ 2.106.5॥

translations.english: O lord of men, it is not proper for a person like you who knows the past and the future of human beings to feel distressed and lament over it.
